description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English
The unique ID of the gateway.

description.zh:
是否开启`Http2`。
- `open`：开启`Http2`。
- `close`：关闭`Http2`。
- `globalConfig`：使用全局配置。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable `Http2`.

- `open`: enables `Http2`.

- `close`: disables `Http2`.

- `globalConfig`: uses the global configuration.
The ID of the domain name that you want to update.
Specifies whether to forcibly redirect requests to HTTPS.
The maximum Transport Layer Security (TLS) version.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse update-gateway-domain --protocol HTTPS --must-https false --cert-identifier 6209108-cn-hangzhou --id 94 --gateway-unique-id gw-86575c0bc9f04ecfbacb92b8e3920000 --http2 close --tls-max TLS_1.3 --tls-min TLS_1.0 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
